summary: REJ1 source-side guard. Scope verified by diff, not by the PR text: exactly broker_adapters/schwab.py (+9/-0) and tests/unit/test_schwab_native_bracket.py (+63/-0); no OMS, strategy, config or deploy path touched. THE DEFECT, re-derived: in sell_state -> walk(), an OCO WRAPPER has no orderLegCollection, so instruction resolves to the empty string, the entire SELL block is skipped, and THE WRAPPER'S OWN STATUS IS NEVER EXAMINED. It contributed nothing to working/filled/unsafe, so the decision tail's early 'if not working: return released' fired BEFORE any DELETE or re-read, and oms/service.py:4190 popped _native_oco_armed_confirmed_at, disarming the stand-down. #898 fixed the DELETE non-2xx tolerance, which sits AFTER that early return, so it never touched this — the 2026-09-03 CHPT mechanism was intact on main. THE GUARD IS CORRECTLY BOUNDED, which is the part that matters most: it fires only when an item has NO legs AND carries a truthy status AND that status is not in CANCELLED_STATUSES | REJECTED_STATUSES | FILLED. So a TERMINAL wrapper still passes, and an anonymous grouping node with no status at all still passes — it cannot turn healthy releases into blanket unanswerable, which was my main review risk since that would silently block every software close. It is placed before the SELL block so it runs for every walked item, and the root ENTRY order carries a BUY leg so it is never flagged. Fails CLOSED: unsafe -> unanswerable, never released. MY OWN MUTATIONS, run against this committed head with a landing probe after each restore, and deliberately in BOTH directions: (1) removing the guard turns test_confirmation_release_refuses_childless_working_oco_wrapper RED, proving it does something; (2) widening it to flag EVERY legless item regardless of status turns test_confirmation_release_accepts_childless_terminal_oco_wrapper RED, proving it is bounded. Restored: 27/27. That two-directional pair is what makes this more than a green suite. The happy path is also still pinned by test_confirmation_release_cancels_working_oco_and_confirms_no_sell_remains. CONTROLLED PAIR against this PR's own base: base ee194e19 46 failed / 3272 passed, head 46 failed / 3274 passed, delta +2 which is exactly the new tests, failure sets extracted and DIFFED BY NAME and IDENTICAL. Codex reported 55/3263 and 55/3265 on its platform — a different count but the SAME +2 delta, the same environment gap recorded on the #898, #902 and #907 pins. NOT COVERED: this is the SOURCE-side guard only. The OMS-side defence I originally proposed is deliberately absent and codex-2 was right to refuse it — the OMS receives only the string 'released' and cannot distinguish an inferred release from a positively-confirmed one without a new explicit result contract, which is a separate and larger change. Also uncovered: no live confirmation-exit release has occurred since this shipped, so the fixed path is UNEXERCISED in production.
